question: Will any rat-like mabeasts show up?
answer: “Opossum” Bahnasshi. They make their nests in dead-ends, and have the habit of attacking those that wander in. I’m not sure they’ll show up in the main story. (Note: 袋鼠 literally translates as bag-rat. Google translate says opossum, google image search has pictures of kangaroos.)
